header.name: Alex Morgan
header.headline: Principal Architect | Distributed Systems, AWS, Enterprise AI

sections.title: Professional Summary
paragraphs: Principal architect with 18 years building and modernizing transaction platforms in banking. Work spans hands-on backend engineering, AWS migration, event-driven architecture on Kafka, and more recently the first production LLM applications in the payments organization. Comfortable owning an architecture end to end - the design review, the proof of concept, and the standard the other teams then build against.

roles.title: Principal Engineer
roles.context: Architecture ownership for the payments platform: 40 services, ~9M transactions/day, 60 engineers across six teams.
bullets: Designed the **Kafka** event backbone that replaced 30-odd point-to-point integrations between the deposits, ledger and fraud systems. Downstream teams now subscribe to account events instead of negotiating a new interface each time, which cut the typical integration from a quarter of work to about two weeks.

Led the migration of the settlement engine from a shared Oracle instance to **AWS** EKS with per-service Postgres. Ran the dual-write and reconciliation plan personally for the first three services, then handed the pattern to the platform team as a documented runbook.

Built the first production **RAG** application in the payments organization - an operations assistant over 12 years of incident write-ups and runbooks. Wrote the retrieval and evaluation layer; a two-engineer team now owns it.
Chair the payments architecture review. Wrote the standards for service boundaries, idempotency and event schema evolution that all six teams now build against.
Reduced Sev-1 incidents in the settlement path from 14 in 2021 to 3 in 2024 by instrumenting the whole flow with **OpenTelemetry** and rebuilding the retry semantics around idempotency keys.

prior_titles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Owned the real-time fraud scoring service - Java, 4k TPS at peak, sub-40ms p99. Rewrote the feature pipeline when the model team moved from batch to streaming features.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained the core order-management services for a retail client processing about 200k orders a day.
Introduced the team's first automated integration test suite and CI pipeline, which took release preparation from two days to under an hour.
